REFERENCE: OpenMower
URL: https://github.com/Gigabyte00/openmower
ROLE IN EDEN DESIGN
Tiny ground-machine reference: low-cost mower conversion, custom hardware, RTK/map-aware autonomy, safety and separated firmware/navigation/UI. Benchmark for Nandi Ground; verify component-specific licenses before reuse.

STATUS
Reference / integration candidate. Not a canonical dependency until architecture, license, safety and prototype validation are completed.
